DARTH VADER RESPECT THREAD (PART 3) - CITED EXTRACTION
======================================================
Post: "Darth Vader Respect Thread (Part 3)" by [member], May 14, 2016 (78 reader comments, skipped)
URL: https://comicvine.gamespot.com/profile/[member]/blog/darth-vader-respect-thread-part-3/127003/
Extracted: 2026-10-10 (UTC), from the rendered blog text of the post body.
Sections: Telekinesis (items 1-64), Combat skill / Accolades (items 65-86), Feats (items 87-129).
Numbering is sequential across the post in the order it appears.

CONVENTIONS
- Quote: verbatim from the post, including the post's spelling, punctuation and typos. Long passages are excerpted; omitted spans are marked [...]. Nothing is paraphrased inside quote fields.
- "image-only": the post shows an image with this caption and no quoted text. The caption is given as written in the post.
- Type: "feat" = a described action by Vader. "statement" = a described claim about Vader's skill or status.
- Source named in post: the title or attribution that follows the quote. "none named" = the post names no source. "Credit to X" lines are recorded as credits (who supplied the image or find), not as sources.
- Label (Legends / Canon / unclear): my classification, NOT stated by the post. Pre-2014 Expanded Universe titles (novels, comics, game guides, RPG books, games, databank entries) = Legends. Post-2014 Disney-era canon = Canon. Writeurl links, podcasts, interviews, and items with no source named = unclear. Verify before relying on a label.
- Scaling: only what the quote or caption itself states. Where a scaling claim comes from the poster's own text rather than the quote or caption, that is marked "poster text".
- Poster commentary, uncited rankings, and reader comments are not treated as items. Where a commentary sentence sits next to a cited quote, it is noted on that item.

POST PROBLEMS (flagged, not corrected)
- Item 84: the Mace Windu quote is about Kar Vastor, not Vader. (Quote is from the Shatterpoint source; it says Mace "couldn't win such a battle on his best day" against Vastor.)
- Item 94: the "Stomping PROXY" caption is paired with a Vader vs Obi-Wan Kenobi quote (The Force Unleashed). The quote does not mention PROXY.
- Item 45: source named as "The Last Jedi". That title is ambiguous and the post gives no further detail. Label left unclear.
- Item 71: the first excerpt is followed by a bare "--" with no title. The only title named is after the second excerpt.
- Item 85: the quote does not name Mace Windu; the post's wording ("including Mace Windu") is the poster's gloss.
- Item 91: the passage is about Roan Shryne's own swordsmanship, not a Vader feat.
- Item 109: the quote is about the Starkiller clone, not Vader.
- Item 121: poster statement with no source named.
- Item 111: the source is a podcast/interview (Far, Far Away: Episode VIII), not a Legends or Canon work.

[12] Section: Telekinesis | Type: feat
Caption: "He hurls a stone table at Starkiller, sending him crashing through three pillars and proceeds to toss him toward an icy cliff:"
Quote: "Before Starkiller could reach out for where his lightsaber lay fallen on the ground, the stone conference table lifted into the air and hurled itself at him. Crashing through three of the pillars and catching him squarely in the chest, it drove him out into the snow. Ignoring everyone else in the room, Vader strode heavily after him, lightsaber raised. [--] Vader casually tossed him toward the icy cliff. He slid across the ground, clutching weakly at the snow, and then spilled over the edge. The world turned for a moment and he thought he might have fainted as he fell. The bottom of the cliff was thousands of meters below, impossibly distant. It didn't seem to be coining closer, which puzzled him momentarily."
Source named in post: "-- The Force Unleashed" (after the second excerpt)
Label: Legends
Scaling stated: quote says "thousands of meters below" (fall height, not a scaling of Vader's power)

He blocked a savage slash that would have cut him in two and another that would have lifted his head clean from his shoulders."

Guards posted at a distance in the hallway nearby were nearly knocked off their feet by it. But the strength of the emanation had not been directed at them. Casually, as if inspecting a new exhibit that had been donated to the Imperial Museum, Vader walked around the now motionless figure on the floor. Aurra Sing lay on her back, unable to move. It was as if a giant weight pressed her down."

[34] Section: Telekinesis | Type: feat
Caption: "He causes a door to explode inward. Even though he was seemingly amped, I still consider this a legitimate feat, because he has done better things without help:" (last part is poster commentary, uncited)
Quote: "The Dark Lord reached out with the Force. Ripples of dark-side energy rolled toward the building and, though he couldn't see it with his eyes, Vader felt the door with the Force. It was right in front of him. Still using the Force, Vader tried to push the door open, but it would not move. Behind his black mask, the Dark Lord frowned. He didn't know whether the door was locked or just frozen shut with age. He didn't care. Gathering the dark side around him, Vader shoved with his mind, and the hidden door exploded inward."
Source named in post: "-- Galaxy Of Fear: Clones"
Label: Legends
Scaling stated: none in quote. "Seemingly amped" and "legitimate feat" are poster commentary.

[37] Section: Telekinesis | Type: feat
Caption: "He shatters a mirror made of aluminized densecris, a substance deemed unbreakable:"

When he allowed the breath to be drawn from him by the respirator, he thrust his right hand toward a nearby mirror. The aluminized densecris shattered into a thousand pieces, struck by the dark side as if by a metal fist. Vader was aware of the \"unbreakable\" substance splintering and falling, tinkling onto the floor, myriad reflections sparkling in the light as they seemed to move in slow motion."

[87] Section: Feats | Type: feat
Caption (poster text): "Despite the fact that he is still not used to his suit, Vader kills Jedi Master Bol Chatak:"
Quote: "Chatak held her blue blade at shoulder height. \"My only intent is to take you out of the hunt.\" Vader's angled his blade to point toward the ground. \"You won't be the first Jedi I've killed.\" [...] Just long enough to glimpse Chatak, all grace and speed, working her way into her opponent's space. Her moves were broad and circular, and the lightsaber seemed an extension of her. Vader, by contrast, was clumsy, and his strikes were mostly vertical. He was, however, a full head taller than Chatak and incredibly powerful. At various times his stances and techniques mimicked those of Ataru and Soresu, but Vader appeared to lack a style of his own, and executed his moves stiffly. [...] A pained cry cut through the chaos, and the crowd of prisoners parted just long enough for Shryne to see Chatak down on her knees in front of Vader, her sword arm amputated at the elbow. Vader had simply beaten her into submission , and now, with a flick of his bloodshine blade, he decapitated her."

[92] Section: Feats | Type: feat
Caption (poster text): "A far from prime Vader defeats Sa Cuis, one of the Emperor's Hands:"
Quote: "Your hatred will make you strong. [...] Vader stepped out onto the lawn, clear of the trees, and waited like bait. [...] Vader matched him step for step in the standoff as they circled each other. [...] There had once been a boy called Anakin who could have done that with sheer technique, but he was forgotten, and the transformed man that was Vader opted for sheer power and began a fast, furious slashing assault, slicing through a tree trunk as Cuis dodged behind it. [...] Vader couldn't match Cuis's agility, so instead he reached out with his left hand: the Force seized Cuis's throat. [...] He could have killed him in that instant. [...] He let go completely and Cuis pitched forward, taking huge gulps of air with the sucking wheeze of a dying old man."
Source named in post: "Credit to Azronger" then "--In His Image"
Label: Legends (pre-2014 novel; verify)
Scaling stated: a sentence omitted from the excerpt says the rage "given him the power to defeat a faster Jedi" (full sentence: "seeing how it had swept through him and given him the power to defeat a faster Jedi and keep the memories locked deep within"); caption says "far from prime"

Without a Master, such advancement would have been impossible for most, but Skywalker's unparalleled aptitude makes him a match for Darth Vader in their fateful duel onboard the second Death Star. Both are limited, Vader by his cybernetic body parts and Skywalker by his relative lack of experience dueling. But Skywalker's skill at blaster deflection is highly refined, and his lightsaber technique so superb that he is able to duel the Dark Lord on even footing - and finally able to defeat a man who is a powerful living product of the ancient Jedi sword traditions from time immemorial. Such an achievement with little formal training is a testament to Skywalker's innate abilities and instinctive skill. Tremendously strong with the Force, Skywalker never crosses the line into Sith hatefulness and ceases his attack immediately upon rendering his foe helpless - an even more impressive demonstration of self-mastery than his lightsaber skills."
